title.es: Réplica de la Estatua de la Libertad

generated.description: A large sandstone replica of the Statue of Liberty, standing about 52 blocks wide, 127 high and 52 deep, with a stepped base, robed figure and raised torch arm. Built mostly from sandstone with stone slab trim, diamond block accents, glowstone lighting and birch plank and oak door details. Around 20,800 blocks in total; the interior is not furnished beyond the lighting and a few doors and torches.
